process.title: From problem to *product*
process.intro: A clear process, so you always know what happens next.

steps.name: Discover
steps.body: Understand your users, business rules and constraints before drawing anything.
steps.example: SalesPoint: workshops with each operator to map KYC, activation and approval rules.

steps.name: Define
steps.body: Turn what we learn into a clear problem, user flows and structure.
steps.example: Flowance: one question, 'how much do I have left?', shaped the whole home screen.

steps.name: Design
steps.body: From wireframes to polished UI, built on a system so it stays consistent.
steps.example: Shamat: an Arabic-first reading layout with a dedicated Quran typeface.

steps.name: Test
steps.body: Compare options side by side and choose with evidence, not opinion.
steps.example: SalesPoint: competing activation flows compared side by side before building.

steps.name: Build & hand off
steps.body: Hand over specs, tokens and components, or build the front end myself.
steps.example: U CAN: redesigned and shipped as a working app with my own front-end code.

aboutPage.title: About
intro: I'm Hamza, a senior UI/UX and product designer and design team lead in Amman, Jordan. For four years I've turned complex business, like telecom KYC, approvals and a full commission engine, into products people use every day.

I own a design system that runs five operators and two brands in one app, in light and dark, Arabic and English. I also build what I design: fully interactive prototypes in Figma and Claude Code, and web and mobile apps from zero to deployment in React and React Native.

how.title: How I think
items: Systems before screens: one set of components that adapts to many brands, modes and languages.
Business first: I write clear requirements and agree them with the client before drawing a screen.
Decide with evidence: I compare options side by side and test before building.
Close to the client: meetings, feature presentations, follow-up and feedback until users are happy with the flows.
Lead through standards: I manage the design team and resources, and review components before they enter the library.
Ship it for real: interactive prototypes, then working front-end code, not only Figma files.

items.role: Senior UI/UX Designer & Design Team Lead
items.body: Lead the design team and its resources. Design system owner for a dealer platform used by five telecom operators, including Beyond ONE's two brands (FRiENDi mobile and Virgin Mobile) in light and dark, Arabic and English, with per-brand fonts. UX for complex business like the commission engine, KYC and approvals. Client meetings, feature presentations and feedback follow-up, including on-site visits.
Designed and built the conference management platform end to end: the attendee portal and the admin back end, from first wireframes to deployment.
Designed core dealer flows (KYC, SIM activation, billing) and built the first shared component library that grew into the design system. Promoted to senior in October 2022.
